name: Porsås - Nornäs
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; remote rural stage on old paths, gravel/country roads and forest paths

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 22 Porsås - Nornäs
keyFacts: Official name is 22. Porsås - Nornäs.
Official WST facts are 7 km, 3 h and Blue / medium.
Responsible municipality is Tanum.
WST describes easy hiking terrain on old paths, countryside/gravel roads and forest paths.

Route description includes Göpadalen, marsh/rock-field terrain with small tarns, a ruined church-village area between the trail start and geographical Porsåsen, Bufjället/Porsås high point and Nornäs by Kornsjön/Mellan-Kornsjön.
WST says public transport access is poor and names Loviseholm about 2 km east of Porsås as the nearest bus-access clue.
WST says Nornäs is easiest by car and the Swedish text warns drivers to respect private-road signs from road 166, instead parking by road 166/Norane and walking about 1.5 km.
caveats: English WST text omits the Swedish private-road/Norane access warning and has machine-translation artifacts; prefer Swedish semantics for access notes.
Official fixed-bus wording for Loviseholm could not be confirmed in current Västtrafik stop data.

officialSources.title: Official WST/Hoodin GPX: Etapp22_Porsas_nornas.gpx
keyFacts: GPX geometry has 1182 raw trackpoints.
Computed length is about 6.922 km.
Geometry is one segment with no internal gaps, but has 788 consecutive duplicate points.
After collapsing consecutive duplicate coordinates there are about 394 effective vertices.
caveats: De-duplicate consecutive repeated points before normalization if the import pipeline expects compact geometry.
Do not use Stage 22 geometry to bridge the Stage 21 partial-geometry gap.

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails: Stage 21 Flötemarksön - Porsås
